_note: BUILD B1 (D1): the prioritization model's published table for Wichita — three option sets from the API (shelter-inventory, transition-programs, intake-network) and the three named users the engine serves (Jordan, Tanya and Luis get their views in builds 2 and 4). Annotations read a limit the data states only in a record's text; each quotes that record's own words (checked). slotsAvailable is read as a program's capacity: CrossRoads' 12 and BRIDGES' 8 match their bed counts in shelter-inventory (an inference, published in the factor's why). Review (11/03): HumanKind (permanent supportive housing) is left out of "A bed tonight" in its own words; ETV's enrollment condition is read from its record (to confirm for Maya); each program shows its eligibility text; an attribute derived from an age is assumed, with its reason. BUILD B2: a fourth set, "A place to rent" (rehousing-options), on the Architect page only (pages), for the housing readiness tracker; the intake (four steps), the plan, the checklist (stabilization-docs in unlock order), the navigator (the programs set) and the readiness steps; the doors' contact fields for the plan; Robert's veteran status as an eligibility the rental table reads (stated from his role).
